question: Describe the names of neutral alignment superheroes.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "superheroes_alignment" AS CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE superheroes_alignment AS
WITH t2 AS (
  SELECT
    id AS hero_id,
    superhero_name,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(split_part(coalesce(combined_ids, ''), '|', 7)) IN ('', 'nan') THEN NULL
      ELSE try_cast(split_part(combined_ids, '|', 7) AS INTEGER)
    END AS alignment_id
  FROM table_2
),
clean_table_1 AS (
  SELECT
    id AS alignment_id,
    CASE WHEN lower(coalesce(qz, '')) IN ('', 'nan') THEN NULL ELSE qz END AS qz_clean,
    CASE WHEN lower(coalesce(hz, '')) IN ('', 'nan') THEN NULL ELSE hz END AS hz_clean
  FROM table_1
),
label_table AS (
  SELECT alignment_id, (qz_clean || hz_clean) AS alignment_name
  FROM clean_table_1
)
SELECT
  t2.hero_id,
  t2.superhero_name,
  t2.alignment_id,
  label_table.alignment_name
FROM t2
LEFT JOIN label_table USING (alignment_id)
